source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
If this model has a cult sniper rifle, this unit may make a Normal move up to 6" in the opposing player’s [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) if both of these are true:

- an enemy unit finishes a move with this unit within 8" of it
- this unit is outside [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of all enemy units

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
